conflicts.title: Session State Representation Conflict
conflicts.description: Session state stored with multiple incompatible schemas: SessionState (Python), session_serializer (JSON), ContextFrame (memory). No canonical schema.
evidence: No unified session state contract exists

conflicts.title: Agent Decision Authority Conflict
conflicts.description: OODA loop confidence thresholds documented as configurable (>0.70) but hardcoded in registry.py. Documentation claims threshold is tunable, code says it's fixed.

conflicts.title: State Transition Semantics Divergence
conflicts.description: OODA loop sequence documented as O→O→D→A but runtime enforces O→D→A→V→P with optional handoff. Mermaid diagrams show different order.
evidence: Mermaid diagrams in docs/: conflicting sequences

conflicts.title: Tool Capability Truth Divergence
conflicts.description: GitHub MCP server capabilities documented as read-write but runtime implementation is read-only. Contract says write_capability=false.

conclusion.primary_issue: Multiple subsystems claim authority without enforcement mechanism
conclusion.recommendation: Establish single source of truth (code is canonical, docs derive from code)
